name: archify-studio
description: An offline architecture and evidence workspace built on Archify.

scripts.check: node --check studio/app.mjs && node --check studio/model.mjs && node --check studio/build.mjs && node --check studio/serve.mjs && npm test && npm run check:contracts
scripts.check:python: python -m compileall -q studio/tools && python -m unittest discover -s studio/tools -p test_*.py -v
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:python
